subject: design/plan-new-routed-demand
statement: Existing plan/v1 source and generated bytes remain valid and immutable. Plangate retains its v1 parser/projector only for frozen inputs; it does not add assessment fields, citations, profiles, or checkpoint rubrics to them. Their `/implement-now` demand is created later by the fixed no-rewrite compatibility path in `execution-demand-contract-v1`.
